name: Redefine Properties Limited
source: Redefine Properties Limited group annual results for the year ended 31 August 2026, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income and statement of financial position (summarised from the audited annual financial statements, PricewaterhouseCoopers unmodified opinion, published 2 November 2026), figures R000 scaled to ZAR. Revenue is the statement total revenue (11,297,081); Cost of Sales is the printed operating costs (4,513,802) so Gross Profit is revenue less operating costs; Operating Expenses is administration costs 680,510 less the 26,008 expected credit loss credit on trade receivables, so Revenue less Operating Expenses equals the printed net operating profit 6,128,777; Net Finance Costs is finance costs 3,607,848 less finance income 680,385. Profit Before Tax equals the printed 7,666,784 after the fair value adjustments, equity accounted income and a 503,440 foreign exchange gain. FY2025 column restated from the same statement comparatives. Net Profit is the printed profit for the year 7,277,821 including the 50,255 non-controlling interest, so Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit exactly; profit attributable to Redefine shareholders is 7,227,566.
